# Lab 15.3: Graph Query Language (GQL)

## What We Are Going to Do
Query the graph with MATCH patterns, multi-hop and variable-length paths, and mix GQL with normal SQL.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Simple pattern.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">GRAPH lab15.FinGraph
MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Dana'})-[:Owns]-&gt;(a:Account)-[t:Transfers]-&gt;(b:Account)
RETURN p.name, a.id AS from_account, b.id AS to_account, t.amount;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Filters with WHERE.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">GRAPH lab15.FinGraph
MATCH (a:Account)-[t:Transfers]-&gt;(b:Account {is_blocked: TRUE})
WHERE t.amount &gt; 100
RETURN a.id, b.id, t.amount;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Variable-length paths.** All accounts reachable from account 7 in 1 to 3 hops:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">GRAPH lab15.FinGraph
MATCH (a:Account {id: 7})-[:Transfers]-&gt;{1,3}(b:Account)
RETURN DISTINCT b.id AS reachable_account;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Use a graph inside SQL.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT owner, total_sent
FROM GRAPH_TABLE(
  lab15.FinGraph
  MATCH (p:Person)-[:Owns]-&gt;(a:Account)-[t:Transfers]-&gt;(:Account)
  COLUMNS (p.name AS owner, t.amount AS amount)
)
|&gt; AGGREGATE SUM(amount) AS total_sent GROUP BY owner
|&gt; ORDER BY total_sent DESC;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[CLI] Run GQL from bq.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'GRAPH lab15.FinGraph MATCH (p:Person)-[:Owns]-&gt;(a:Account) RETURN p.name, a.id'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `MATCH` | ASCII-art patterns of nodes and edges |
| `{1,3}` | 1 to 3 hops |
| `GRAPH_TABLE` | Graph results as a normal table |
| Mixing | Graph + SQL + pipe syntax |
